message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to datasets or experiment parameters anywhere in the visible code.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from sklearn built-in datasets and local files with no remote fetching, so there is no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values, checks label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training samples at any point in the pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using ensemble wrappers and never loads pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification is performed or needed, but no such control exists.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any part of the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/val splits are used, there is no signed or hashed evaluation data, no truly isolated held-out test set enforced programmatically, and no safeguards preventing the validation set from leaking into training or results from being manipulated.

No detected input sanitization: There is no input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation applied to datasets or parameters before they are passed to the model's fit/predict methods.

No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions from ensemble.predict() are passed directly to accuracy_score without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML ensemble models (RandomForest, XGBoost, LGB, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
